abilities.text: At the start of the battle, you can set up one Teleport Homer token for this unit on the battlefield. If you do: When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, you can use that Teleport Homer token. If you do, that use is -1 CP, but when resolving that stratagem, this unit must be set up within 3" of that Teleport Homer token and not within 8" of an enemy unit.
